title: Anti-Azali protest at Volo-Volo, Moroni
organizer: Daula Ya Haki youth; Front Commun reported coordination
threshold_50_evidence: No documented public attendance count or clear qualitative evidence establishing >=50.

title.summary: HaYba/Habariza reports Volo-Volo youth banners demanding Azali departure and a dispersed protest. A coordinated nationwide movement is claimed, so this site and the Ntsaweni-Hahaya procession are provisional linked records, not established independent MM events. Attendance remains unknown. Journalist Mchangama was arrested while covering this site and denies participating; other reported January7 protest arrests lack reliable site allocation, so arrests remains unknown at this site pending review.
